Ella Ops: Quick heads-up — our company all-hands is scheduled for Friday 10:00 AM PT. Please read below for agenda, logistics, and how to submit Qs.

Matt R.: Is there a hybrid link for folks remote?

Ella Ops: Yep — join here: https://meet.google.com/rvp-zoom-meet (recording will be captured). Calendar invite updated.

Jen (CEO): Quick agenda draft — please weigh in.

```
10:00 - 10:10: CEO update (Jen)
10:10 - 10:25: Product roadmap & launches (Lina) — Redwood Dedicated GA callouts
10:25 - 10:35: Incident summary & reliability improvements (SRE)
10:35 - 10:50: Customer stories + sales highlights (Sales)
10:50 - 11:00: Q&A
```

Lina - Product: I’ll include a 5-min demo of Optimize recommendations and quantization profiles. Can teams add a one-slide callout if you have a customer story?

Sanjay K.: For the incident section — can we add two quick graphs (latency & error trend) to the SRE slide deck?

Ella Ops: Yes — @eng-sre, please attach those graphs to the shared slide deck by Thursday EOD. Link to slide deck: https://docs.internal/redwood/allhands-may-deck (edit access for leads).

ops-bot: Reminder: All-hands calendar event created and invite sent to @everyone. Recording is enabled. :bell:

Ella Ops: Collecting Qs here — drop questions in thread or add to the doc: https://docs.internal/redwood/allhands-questions. If you want to ask live, say "live" next to your question.

Matt R.: Quick ask — will we cover Dedicated pricing and rollout timeline? Customers are asking.

Jen (CEO): Yes, pricing/commit model and private deployment progress will be covered in the roadmap section. We’ll call out the expected GA window and support tiers.

Ella Ops: Action items: 1) Team leads — one-slide customer callouts by Wed EOD. 2) Eng-SRE — attach latency/error charts by Thu EOD. 3) Product — finalize slides & demo script by Thu EOD.

Lina - Product: I’ll follow up here when slides are finalized.

Sanjay K.: Thanks — adding charts now.

Ella Ops: Thanks all — posting recording link after the meeting and a short takeaway doc (1 pager) within 24 hours. If anything urgent to add to agenda reply here. :thumbsup:
